mutations.label: RD1 #1026b ON THE COMMONEST LIVE SIGNAL: the `checked` conjunct goes, so a walk that NEVER RAN the real-data check reports no_real_data=True. Measured over 114 UNUSABLE verdicts in the run logs, no_real_data is on in 90 (79%) and is the ONLY signal on in 54 -- a false positive here is the single most expensive one in the gate
RD2 the `not rendered` conjunct goes, so merely HAVING checked reports no real data even when seed values did render -- every app with a working frontend is blocked
RD3 the test is inverted: real data RENDERING is reported as no real data and a mock twin passes -- googlemaps run-3's exact defect, which this gate exists to catch
RD4 the signal is never written at all, so `browser_unusable_signals` cannot see it and the 79%-of-verdicts blocker silently stops existing -- the arrival half, distinct from computing it wrongly
